FAQ for This Card

Q340

July 10, 2026 Updated

If this Unit is paired with an (Orb) Pilot, does this effect activate when it is destroyed even if there are no other (Orb) Pilots on my field?

Yes. Since the 【Destroyed】 effect checks the card's last state prior to it leaving the field, the effect activates if the Pilot was paired with this Unit.
